title: Indoor Sprint
description: 3-round HIIT with burpees, jump lunges, box jumps and single leg hops for explosive cardio

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Butt kicks
exercises.instructions: Run in place, heels toward the glutes

exercises.name: Inchworms
exercises.instructions: Standing, walk hands forward into a plank, then walk back

exercises.name: Moderate high knees
exercises.instructions: Knees to chest at a moderate pace

exercises.name: Burpees
exercises.instructions: Drop down, place your hands, jump feet back, do a push-up, jump up

exercises.name: Box jumps (step)
exercises.instructions: Jump onto a low step or platform, then step down

exercises.name: Single leg hops
exercises.instructions: Hops on one leg, staying balanced

exercises.name: Depth jumps
exercises.instructions: Step down from a low platform, touch the ground and jump immediately

exercises.name: Standing quad stretch
exercises.instructions: Grab your foot behind you, knee toward the floor

exercises.name: Pigeon stretch
exercises.instructions: Front leg bent in front, back leg extended, lean forward

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.instructions: On all fours, alternate cat and cow, breathe

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
